title: Proximity Link Snap Outside Detail Lod
description: Fix proximity link snap so it runs at overview/normal LOD (Nakagin default zoom), not only detail/micro.
summary: Stacked a pointer-events-none text overlay canvas in BoardCanvas and bind it via BoardRenderer.attachTextOverlayCanvas so node and detail handle captions paint above the WebGPU layer. WASM host: minimap returns no discrete hit targets; overview keeps indirect ring + sole-handle hits without direct-handle resolve; normal/detail/micro draw and hit-test direct anchors; proximity link snap restricted to detail/micro again so normal/sole-target flows emit indirectConnect. Added detail LOD handle caption helper + catalog lookup cache, Handle.iconKind on the TS scene graph, and host tests for minimap, normal rim hits, overview omit-direct, plus removed obsolete overview proximity drag helper.
